data.case_title: Mobile Working Addendum – Beispiel Logistik GmbH
data.title: Supplementary agreement on mobile working
data.summary: Beispiel Logistik GmbH's HR department sent Mara Beispiel a supplementary agreement (Zusatzvereinbarung) to her employment contract, allowing mobile working up to two days per week starting 1 June 2026, and asked for the signed copy to be returned within 10 working days of the letter's date.
data.explanation: Your employer has offered you an addendum to your employment contract that permits working remotely up to two days a week from 1 June 2026. You should review, sign and return this addendum to HR by the deadline shown (counted in working days, Monday to Saturday, excluding public holidays, from the letter's date). The letter does not say what happens if you miss the deadline, but it's best to respond promptly or contact HR if you need more time. This arrangement may also let you claim the home office allowance (Homeoffice-Pauschale) on your tax return for days worked from home.
